turns.question: What share of total non-cancelled order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026 came from the top three customers by revenue, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the share of revenue from the top three customers and cannot rank customers, so I cannot give that percentage; the closest figures are Revenue (EUR) of 19,506.59 EUR for 17 August to 2 October 2026 (non-cancelled orders) and Repeat-customer revenue share of 1.0 (100%) for the same period.
